bullets.title: DELL: Massive Q3 beat — AI server backlog $132B, FY27 EPS raised 16%, $25B buyback
bullets.body: Dell crushed Q3: revenue $54.94B vs $49.32B est (11% beat), EPS $9.45 vs $6.60 (43% beat), ISG $41.97B vs $35.27B est. FY27 guidance raised to $202B revenue (+78% YoY) and $29.68 EPS (+188% YoY); AI-optimized server revenue target raised to $78B (+3x YoY). Record $132.3B AI backlog after $60.2B of Q3 orders; 7,500+ customers on AI Factories; opex fell to 7% of revenue (42-year low). Stock +4.1% AH; Goldman desk noted ISG OMs up ~2pts q/q.

bullets.title: NVDA: Export control scandal intensifies — Schumer accusations, DOJ ambiguity, ~75% odds of legislation by Feb
bullets.body: Senate Democratic leader Schumer accused Jensen Huang of shipping advanced chips to China in violation of export controls; DOJ/FBI declined to clarify whether a criminal investigation is open. Huang is expected to testify Dec 3 before Senate Banking and three House Committees. One macro desk puts ~75% probability that chip export control legislation (MATCH Act, AI Overwatch Act, Chip Security Act, or NDAA vehicle) passes by February. NVDA -5.9% Tuesday; semis -8.6%.

bullets.title: NVDA/Semis: JPM tactically cautious; 2028 AI numbers viewed as too high
bullets.body: JPM's desk downgraded to tactically cautious on Mag-7/semis (Mag-7 -1.7%, semis -8.6% on the day). Desk notes 2028 AI/semiconductor earnings numbers are too high and need proper cuts to reset valuation bar; real money flows today favored EM, REITs, and broad US over Mag-7. Comparison drawn to late-2018 tactical bounce pattern.

bullets.title: NVDA: JPM 2027 outlook — largest S&P 500 earnings contributor; hyperscaler capex +97% YoY to ~$900B
bullets.body: JPM's 2027 US Equity Outlook targets S&P 500 at 8,200 (19x $430 EPS, +17% YoY); semis account for ~60% of 2027E S&P earnings growth with Nvidia as the largest single contributor. Hyperscaler capex forecast +97% YoY to ~$900B in 2026, +87% to $1.7T in 2027. Key risks: hawkish Fed, rising cost of capital, and regulatory friction on data center buildouts.

bullets.title: HPE: Beats Q3, +2% AH on dividend increase; supply constraints and peak growth concerns linger
bullets.body: HPE gained ~2% after hours after reporting a Q3 beat and announcing a dividend increase. Broader commentary flags supply constraints and peak growth concerns as lingering headwinds for the infrastructure complex.

bullets.title: MU downgraded to Neutral at BNP Paribas Exane; CRWD upgraded to Buy at Guggenheim
bullets.body: BNP Paribas Exane downgraded Micron (MU) to Neutral from Outperform. Separately, Guggenheim Securities upgraded CrowdStrike (CRWD) to Buy from Neutral.

bullets.title: TSLA/SpaceX merger: RBC sees early-2027 announcement possible; receptive at ~$480/share (+15% premium)
bullets.body: TSLA and SpaceX have appointed five board members to lead merger negotiations and hired financial advisers. RBC estimates Tesla holders would be receptive at ~$480/share (sum-of-parts intrinsic value plus ~15% premium); announcement could come by early 2027. Key hurdles: exchange ratio given Musk's asymmetric voting control (82% SpaceX vs ~20% TSLA), shareholder vote threshold, and regulatory scrutiny over SpaceX's defense/NASA contracts and Tesla's China assets.

bullets.title: NFLX +1.3%: BBC partnership, NFL Thanksgiving content deal, $380M Radford studio acquisition
bullets.body: Netflix gained 1.3% on the session, driven by a BBC preschool content partnership and an NFL Thanksgiving Eve broadcast featuring a U2 halftime show. Separately, Netflix acquired Radford Studio Center for $380M to expand production infrastructure.

bullets.title: PINS: RBC — updated exec comp protections raise sale odds; Microsoft ad deal a modest positive
bullets.body: RBC says updated executive compensation protections signal the PINS board won't block a sale offer, raising M&A probability. The Microsoft Advertising integration gives Pinterest access to search budgets but limited addressable market given overlap with Google and Amazon distribution. October CFO departure alongside comp protections suggests board concerns on hitting performance targets.

bullets.title: EQIX -1.7%: Data Center REITs down ~1.5% on AI economics concerns; tariff headlines add pressure
bullets.body: Data Center REITs declined ~1.5% as a group amid concerns about AI economics and profitability durability. Equinix fell 1.7%. Trump's reported country-specific tariffs on China and EU pose additional risk to global data center hubs in Malaysia and Singapore.

bullets.title: VST/TLN: IPPs lag utilities; BE -7% on the day; renewables broadly weak
bullets.body: Independent Power Producers NRG, Talen (TLN), and Vistra (VST) lagged the broader electric utilities group which outperformed the S&P. Bloom Energy (BE) fell 7.0%. Renewables were broadly weak with solar leading declines (-2.5%) and Canadian Solar down 14.9%.

bullets.title: GEV confirmed at Goldman Industrials & Materials Conference Dec 2-3 (NYC)
bullets.body: GE Vernova (GEV) will present at the Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference in New York on December 2-3, 2026. The event features 100+ companies across aerospace, defense, industrials, and materials.

bullets.title: SHOP -2.6%, HUT -5.6% in mid-afternoon Canadian trading
bullets.body: Shopify (SHOP) traded down 2.6% to C$187.97 and Hut 8 (HUT) fell 5.6% to C$69.72 in Canadian mid-afternoon trading, with metals/mining broadly declining.

bullets.title: DKNG short crowding has more than tripled in 3 weeks — Citi flags bearish signal
bullets.body: Citi's crowding monitor shows DKNG short interest has more than tripled versus three weeks ago, a notable bearish positioning signal. By contrast, FRPT shows elevated long crowding.

bullets.title: SMTC: Street 94% Buy, $196 avg PT (+88%); FY28 DC revenue >$1B confident, record bookings
bullets.body: Semtech beat Q3 by 1.5%/7.7%/3.5% on revenue/EBITDA/EPS and guided Q4 above consensus. Management expressed confidence FY28 Data Center revenue exceeds $1B; NPO expected as meaningful contributor in H2 FY28. Record bookings and backlog; NTM P/E 16.7x vs 5-year avg 28.0x. Oppenheimer PT $225, Stifel $180, B Riley $190.

bullets.title: TSLA/SPCX merger: Musk flags lack of progress on AI economics, data center capacity rental more profitable
bullets.body: Elon Musk flagged lack of progress on AI economics in the context of SpaceX/Tesla merger committee discussions, noting better profitability from data center capacity rental versus current AI deployment models.

bullets.title: RCL/CCL: UBS hosting Miami cruise field trip March 1-2 with CEO/CFO level access
bullets.body: UBS Research is organizing a Miami cruise industry field trip March 1-2 featuring Carnival Corp (CCL) CEO Josh Weinstein on March 1 and Royal Caribbean (RCL) CFO Naftali Holtz on March 1.

bullets.title: SPOT, APP, AMZN, MSFT, MRVL, MU, SNDK: Jefferies corporate access calendar — CES 2027 meetings Jan 5-7
bullets.body: Jefferies calendar includes a Spotify HQ visit Dec 1 (NYC), AppLovin post-Black Friday expert calls Dec 4, Microsoft webinar Dec 9, Amazon e-commerce expert call Dec 10, and CES 2027 hosted meetings Jan 5-7 in Las Vegas featuring SanDisk (SNDK), Micron (MU), and Marvell (MRVL).

bullets.title: NVDA macro context: Monday rally was positioning squeeze not macro confirmation — Goldberg
bullets.body: One macro strategist argues Monday's NVDA-driven rally reflected mechanical positioning relief and risk removal, not an improved macro backdrop. Dollar strength, elevated real yields, and weak oil/Bitcoin suggest global deleveraging continues. Underlying GPU demand remains strong but cannot offset restrictive real rates cyclically; dollar rollover and credit stabilization would be required to confirm a durable bottom.

bullets.title: WSM: Consensus long at 80%+ crowding; elevated volatility expected around upcoming catalysts
bullets.body: Citi's retail crowding monitor flags Williams-Sonoma (WSM) alongside RL, LOW, FIVE, TPR, ROST, and VFC at 80%+ long crowding. RH not flagged explicitly. Two-way debate names including HD show high crowding on both sides, implying elevated volatility around catalyst events.
